# FireClient
> FireClient is a free Minecraft Java launcher for Windows 10/11 with a Fabric in-game client for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Java 21). Early access is live; the full version is planned for November 2026 (exact date not announced).

## Facts
- Draggable HUD with 11 elements and 3 accent themes; menu opens with Right Shift
- Modrinth mod manager, worlds library, memory setting, local skins, Paper server hosting
- Planned, not built: crosshair editor and cosmetics
- Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft
